snippet.title: New Hopepunk City Trailer for Steam Release
snippet.description:
This is an updated trailer that says more about the game to promote the steam release coming March 3, 2025. It will launch with a 15% off sale on that date.  I wasn't planning on releasing this game on Steam because it has a dark undercurrent that I was hoping we would be over with by now, but due to recent events, this game may prove prophetic.

Hopepunk City is a mature rated Adult Visual Novel set in a future time when the US has been broken into pieces. It's a rare game made with Poser instead of Daz Studio or HS giving it a unique look. It's my fourth Visual Novel, and I'm actually pretty proud how it turned out, though it has never found a big audience. There is a "censored" mode if anyone wants to stream it. The game uses AI voices, which can be disabled if you prefer just reading the text. Has lots of licensed sound and music, too.

Steam Page https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348860/Hopepunk_City/
Free online demo: https://arianeb.itch.io/hopepunk-city-free-demo
Home page with more info, game hints, and other ways to purchase: https://arianeb.com/hopepunk-city/
